reviews.detail: Three independent skill activities have Job Levels 30/15/35. The first header is a source summary, not a whole-guide minimum that blocks Crazy Uproar below 30. No combined material fee or forced skill sequence is asserted.
Cart Revolution requires exactly the six stated quantities and fails with excess stock. These are not minimum counts. Bare Alberta trainer points retain NULL map codes.
